title: ProjectionSubscriptionLease
description: A durable subscription lease over an owner-namespaced EventStream: subscriber scope, projection/filter binding, permitted subjects and information-flow labels, expiry and revocation, backpressure bounds, and an acknowledged-checkpoint projection. The family mints NO admission or checkpoint receipt and owns NO transition chain (ADR 0030): every lease transition and every checkpoint advance is a REFERENCE to the canonical Agentgres operation and receipt that admitted it. Delivery adapters (SSE, WebSocket, local broadcast, libp2p, storage) are replaceable and own nothing: an unleased delivery is refused, and lag never silently drops an accepted event — it yields a typed gap or rebase outcome.

stream_id.description: The leased stream. A lease is scoped to exactly one owner-namespaced stream.

subscriber_ref.description: The principal or component the lease is issued to. Delivery outside this subscriber is unleased and refused.

lease_state.description: Lease lifecycle. Expiry and revocation both stop delivery; neither rewrites admitted stream truth.

expires_at_ref.description: Reference to the authenticated time source binding for this lease's expiry. Time trust is an owner concern, referenced rather than asserted here.

projection_binding.description: What this lease may observe. The filter is content-bound so a substituted projection cannot be presented as the leased one.

permitted_event_class_ids.description: Owner-declared class ids this lease may receive; classes outside the set are not delivered.

backpressure.description: Bounded delivery. Exceeding the bound produces a typed outcome; it never silently drops an accepted event.

policy_ref.description: Reference to the canon-owned backpressure/fairness policy vocabulary.

acknowledged_checkpoint.description: The durable acknowledged position. It is a PROJECTION of admitted truth: the position itself is carried by reference, so a checkpoint cannot be advanced by assertion or substituted with a forged scalar.

admitted_lease_transition.description: The canonical Agentgres operation that admitted this lease's current state. The family owns no lease-transition chain of its own.

delivery_adapter_kind.description: The adapter currently carrying delivery (sse, websocket, local_broadcast, libp2p, storage). Adapters are replaceable and own no truth; adapter loss is a delivery fault, never an admitted-truth loss.

agentgresOperationReference.description: A reference to canonical Agentgres truth, produced by the substrate's backed constructors. Fabricated agentgres:// strings are not grandfathered.
